test_item:
The software shall provide a Binder-based interface via the Android Java Service for Java clients, and a dedicated Crypto Library for Native clients, to perform cryptographic operations (sign, verify, encrypt, decrypt).
(keys in INSTALLED state; sign, verify, encrypt and decrypt succeed)
pre: 1. DUT is connected via ADB with root permission (Dev/Eng build)
proc:
1. Read the installation state file in the secure partition
$ adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/installstate
2. Run the KeyMaster wrapper AES encrypt and decrypt normal flow
$ adb shell am instrument -w -e class com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.testkeymasterwrapper.aes.KeyMasterWrapperAesTests#encryptDecryptNormalFlow com.mitsubishielectric.ahu.efw.lib.testkeymasterwrapper.aes/androidx.test.runner.AndroidJUnitRunner
er:
1. The adb shell od -t x1 /mnt/vendor/oemkeys/installstate output shows the installstate value 2
2. The instrumentation runner reports "OK (1 test)" for encryptDecryptNormalFlow
author: PeiPYHsu
remarks:
source: 037 SWE1-KeyInsyall-009 Requirement Description and Verification Criteria
source: Z1 IntegrationTests/PythonTests/common/keys_install_helper.py (installstate path and state values verbatim)
source: Z1 IntegrationTests/PythonTests/KeysInstallationTests/test_java_integration.py (instrument command verbatim)
sibling axis: key state; rule 1,3 of SEC-04 4.2
channel_feasible: Y/Y
apk pairing: encryptDecryptNormalFlow (apk_pairing.tsv)
